items.title: Nog één horde te gaan: dit is de volgende opponent van NEC in CL-voorronde
items.summary: NEC is erin geslaagd om de play-offs van de Champions League te bereiken. De ploeg van Dick Schreuder rekende dinsdagavond af met Olympiakos Piraeus. De laatste horde voor deelname aan het hoofdtoernooi is een tweeluik met FK Bodø/Glimt.

items.title: NEC op Rapport: Tadic en Nejasmic absolute uitblinkers op Nijmeegse feestavond
items.summary: NEC is nog altijd in de race om dit seizoen in de competitiefase van de Champions League uit te komen. Dinsdagavond wonnen de Nijmegenaren van Olympiakos Piraeus en zo plaatsten ze zich voor de play-offs van het miljardenbal. Het levert NEC fraaie rapportcijfers op.

items.title: NEC pakt tegen Olympiakos eerste jackpot
items.summary: NEC heeft met Olympiakos de eerste horde op weg naar de Champions League genomen. De Nijmegenaren spelen volgende week tegen Bodø/Glimt in de play-offs van het elitetoernooi. Voor NEC-begrippen levert dat nu al een hoofdprijs op, ook als de hoofdfase van de Champions League niet wordt bereikt.

items.title: VI Live: Linssen straalt van geluk na zwaarbevochten zege in Champions League
items.summary: NEC speelt dinsdagavond om 19.30 uur de return van de derde voorronde in de Champions League tegen Olympiakos Piraeus. Door de 0-0 van vorige week is de Champions League-droom van de Nijmegenaren nog springlevend. Mis niets van het duel in deze VI Live.

items.title: Ruimte op links: hoe NEC het duel met Olympiakos kantelde
items.summary: NEC heeft voor een stunt gezorgd door Olympiakos Piraeus uit te schakelen: 2-1. Tactische analyse van een wedstrijd waarin Dusan Tadic doorzag hoe Olympiakos kon worden gekraakt.

items.title: ‘I am quite optimistic’: Newcastle’s Jaissle on leading club after turbulent summer
items.summary: The former Al-Ahli head coach, chosen by the Saudi owners to replace Eddie Howe, admits ‘vacuum’ after sale of three key players Matthias Jaissle has been described as “fire” and a “rock star”, but his formal “unveiling” as Newcastle’s manager revealed a rather more considered and conservative character than advertised. At the precise moment the clock struck 3pm on Tuesday the 38-year-old German walked into a packed media suite at St James’ Park. Before taking his seat on the stage Jaissle, wearing a smartly understated open necked suit complete with a silk pocket square, took a deep breath and jumped down into audience, making a point of shaking everyone’s hand. It was a courteous and classy gesture. Continue reading...

items.title: Infantino’s opponents developing new framework for running world football
items.summary: Uefa, Concacaf and AFC working together on system Fifa has ignored calls for an independent review Gianni Infantino’s opponents are working together to produce a new framework for running world football to replace what they regard as a system of patronage that Fifa has adopted since he replaced Sepp Blatter as president 10 years ago. Repeated calls from Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation for an independent review of Fifa’s governance have been ignored by Infantino since his plan to sell off 21% of the World Cup was made public a fortnight ago, and the rebels are now understood to have taken matters into their own hands. Continue reading...

items.title: Djed Spence nears Tottenham exit with Inter in talks over £25.6m move
items.summary: England defender keen on move to Italian champions Udogie and Porro set to be Spurs’ first-choice full-backs Tottenham are prepared to allow Djed Spence to join Inter, with the England defender expected to cost around €30m (£25.6m). Spence – who started four games for England at the World Cup, including the semi-final against Argentina – has fallen further down the pecking order at Spurs after the arrival of Andy Robertson from Liverpool. He signed a new four-year contract in north London at the start of last season but is believed to be keen on joining the Italian champions, with Destiny Udogie and Pedro Porro expected to be Roberto De Zerbi’s preferred full-backs this season. Continue reading...

Chelsea, it is understood, have also been made aware of the 19-year-old’s availability. Lewis-Skelly won the Premier League under Mikel Arteta last term, but whether the west London club will make a move for him is unclear. Continue reading...
